## Scope

The audit reviewed 515 second reads taken during the quarter. It considered the relationship between the first and second grades for each set and assessed whether the recorded results were consistent. The review was limited to the reads included in the audit period. Findings are presented at the overall level, with the supporting information retained in the attached spreadsheet.

## Result

First and second grades agreed in 64.1 per cent of sets. This result represents the overall agreement observed in the audited material. The attached spreadsheet provides the per-grader results for further review. These results will be discussed with each grader privately, allowing the findings to be considered in context and any questions to be addressed directly. The audit outcome should be used alongside the detailed spreadsheet information when reviewing grading consistency and identifying opportunities for improvement.
